sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 35 = check 34; Internal Quality Checks row 35, no extra annotation cells)

qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/raw-evidence-index.json and its artifacts, read from commit 4b3bef67 with git show (results/polish.json, results/runtime.json, tests/polish.cjs, hosted run Rc3y2sT verifier/scored/reward-details.json)
evidence: Every interactive, time-varying and viewport requirement in the public notes has a criterion that tells the judge to act and then observe; none is scored from a first paint. RESPONSIVE: ui.md 'At a phone width of about 390 px ... must all stay usable without sideways page scrolling' is graded by tests/scored/polish/judge.toml cw_narrow_width_usable: 'Resize the browser viewport to about 390 by 844 pixels and reload ... By scrolling only vertically, reach the code editor, the Run control, the preview, the console and the library. At this width type a short line in the editor and see it appear, and press the Run control ... Restore the desktop viewport afterwards.' WAITS: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md Action rules 'Where waiting is required, wait the stated time; do not shorten it.' and the criteria state the waits: cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic 'wait about three seconds without any other input'; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget 'wait at least eight more seconds ... Click the first button: its marker must appear about a second later'; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work 'press Stop as your very next action after Run ... Then wait at least eight more seconds' with a void-and-repeat rule; cw_newer_run_supersedes 'wait at least eight more seconds'; cw_time_limit_recovery 'within about ten seconds a visible time-limit reason must appear'; cw_live_library_update 'without reloading or pressing anything in A, watch its library for up to ten seconds'; cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft 'Wait ten seconds and confirm that A shows no notice ... yet: this is the baseline'. INTERACTION: all 43 functional criteria are written as real key/mouse sequences with read-back (app_context.md 'Enter text with real key presses ... driving the real mouse and keyboard at coordinates'); scroll-following is exercised in cw_caret_kept_in_view (Ctrl+End, Ctrl+Home, typing past the right edge) and cw_long_line_editing; focus visibility by keyboard traversal in cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus; enabled/disabled state changes in cw_undo_redo_availability and cw_unsaved_marker. VISUAL is not a still first paint: tests/scored/visual/prompt.md 'put a ten-line JavaScript draft in the editor and Run it once ... Then click once into the code and watch the caret for about two seconds, because a caret may blink, and take one screenshot that shows it. After that select one word with a double click and take your other screenshots with that selection in place.' The render gate also types and reloads. THEMING: no public requirement for themes, and the golden exposes no theme toggle (style.css has unused [data-theme=light] rules; app.tsx has no data-theme setter), so nothing to toggle. TOOLS: tests/Dockerfile:19 pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, which provides resize, wait, tabs and the code runner the notes rely on. RUN EVIDENCE: index artifact hashes verified against commit 4b3bef67 (20 of 22 match; the two GPT-5.6 Luna run files 2KqFPi3 result.json and gates/reward-details.json do not match the indexed hashes, not relevant to this row). Scripted golden polish.json has cw_narrow_width_usable true (tests/polish.cjs:110 setViewportSize 390x844, scrollWidth check) and runtime.json has all timing criteria true. The hosted judge on the EARLIER candidate actually performed the actions: cw_narrow_width_usable reasoning 'Viewport resized to 390x844 and reloaded: ... scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth 390 ... Desktop viewport (1280x720) restored afterwards'; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work 'Stop was pressed 146ms after Run ... After 9s ... never appeared'; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget '9s after a run finished ...'; visual 'thin light caret was visible ... in three consecutive 120 ms clips and absent in the fourth'. Weak-app probe: an app that looks right on load but overflows at 390 px, has a dead Stop, or never refreshes the library cannot pass these criteria because each requires the action and a later observation; a conforming app with a blinking caret is protected by the two-second watch. NOTES (not defects): (a) the visual prompt says to score 'at a desktop viewport of about 1440 by 900 pixels' but does not say 'resize to'; the default playwright-mcp viewport is 1280x720 (the polish judge restored to that), and the earlier hosted visual judge did use 1440x900, so impact is nil to slight. (b) Narrow-width rendering is graded only as a binary usability check; the template's likert responsive-consistency criterion is not carried, which is a coverage choice, not a still-paint defect. (c) ui.md says the library updates 'within about five seconds' while the criteria allow ten; this is tolerance in the app's favour. (d) No configured judge run exists for these exact bytes; the judge-behaviour observations above come from the earlier candidate and the scripted golden only. (e) During this review, at about 20:27 local, the working tree was switched by another process from task/colderwater-editor-strict to task/hireops-live-desk, so the indexed evidence files are absent from the working tree; they were read and hashed from commit 4b3bef67 instead. The frozen .qc-cache snapshot was unaffected.
